verses.text: Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto ha winh smam winh ix sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh yuj schamel winh smam winh chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita,

ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a ha k'o'ol to niwan yelk'och winh ha mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yujnhej chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil ha k'o'ol heb' winh? Ma'ay. Ix chekjikot heb' winh yuj winh yik syil heb' winh tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb' winh, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' winh schekab' winhaj rey David chi'. Ix joxji'el xil sti' heb' winh, ix polji'el yoktak sti' spichul heb' winh masanto ix k'e'ul t'a sti' syo'op heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tas ix aj heb' winh, ix schekanb'at scha'umal heb' winh yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb' winh. Ix alji t'a heb' winh to skan heb' winh t'a Jericó masanto sk'ib'xi xil sti' heb' winh chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj paxta heb' winh.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix yak'b'at 660 quintal k'e'en plata winhaj Hanún chi' t'a Mesopotamia, t'a Siria, t'a Maaca yet' t'a Soba yik skot carruaje yet' heb' winh soldado et'jinak yet' heb' winh soldado ayk'e yib'anh nok' chej yik skolwaj yet' winh.

Ix stupanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Maaca yik skot winh yet' 32 mil carruaje yik owal yet' soldado. Ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' ix tupchaj chi' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Medeba. Ix elpaxkot masanil heb' amonita chi' t'a yoltak schonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Ix yak' lista sb'a heb' amonita chi' t'a owal t'a yichanh schonhab' heb'. Haxo heb' winh rey ix yawtejkot heb' chi', ch'ok ix kan heb' winh t'a ak'lik.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab to ay heb' ajk'o'ol t'a yichanh yet' t'a spatik, ix sik'anel heb' soldado te jelan winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' ix yak'och winh yik skuchb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Abisai yuktak winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: Tato max honh tzak'wan t'a heb' sirio chi', elanhchamel tzex kolwaj ket'ok. Tato max hex tzak'wan t'a heb' amonita chi' jun, ha honhxo ol b'at honh kolwaj heyet'ok.
Tek'b'ej ha b'a, kak' owal yuj ko kolan heb' ketchonhab', haton schonhab' ko Diosal. Yak'okab' Jehová tas tz'el t'a sk'o'ol, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix el pax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai chi', ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joab chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' ay t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates yik skot heb' kolwal yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Sofac yajalil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer skuchb'an heb'.

Ix alchaj juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado Israel winh, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' heb' sirio chi'. Ix sb'o'anoch soldado winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an owal yet' heb'.
Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'. Ay 40 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok ix chami yet' 7 mil heb' ayk'e t'a yol carruaje. Ix champax winhaj Sofac chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix och heb' t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj rey David chi', ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Atax ta' majxo yal sk'o'ol heb' sirio chi' ix kolwaj yet' heb' amonita.
